title: खेत तलाइ - Farm Pond Construction Subsidy Scheme

sc_st_small_marginal_farmers.kachcha: 70% of unit cost or maximum INR 73500, whichever is lower
sc_st_small_marginal_farmers.plastic_lined: 90% of unit cost or maximum INR 135000, whichever is lower

other_farmers.kachcha: 60% of unit cost or maximum INR 63000, whichever is lower
other_farmers.plastic_lined: 80% of unit cost or maximum INR 120000, whichever is lower

eligibility_summary: Minimum 0.3 hectare cultivable land at one location in the farmer's own name
Joint landholders must meet the minimum 0.3 hectare joint-ownership condition displayed on the portal
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card
Jamabandi copy not older than six months
application_process: Apply through Raj Kisan Sathi portal or nearby e-Mitra centre
construction_conditions: Physical verification before and after construction
Subsidy deposited directly into farmer's bank account
limitations: Portal snapshot does not include a separate government order or notification number
Verify current subsidy amounts and eligibility before giving final advice
Preserve separate subsidy rates for kachcha and plastic-lined ponds
Do not infer additional eligibility conditions
notes: Official Raj Kisan Sathi portal snapshot dated 31 October 2026. Preserve the distinction between kachcha and plastic-lined ponds and the farmer-category subsidy rates.
